flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No interface code to Cumulus (neither sending refund advice nor receiving status). Only the entity OcmsRefundNotices (ocmsadminprivateapi) / OcmsRefundNotice (ocmsadminapi) and the list endpoint /v1/refundnoticelist exist; the Epic46 Refund UI pages in ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx sit inside a comment block.
note: Status Removed. Not claimed. The word Cumulus does not appear in any of the six repos (grep cumulus: 0 hits). Table ocms_refund_notice only stores refund data with no status or reason column from an external party. No maintenance ticket changes this verdict; OCMS-SR-2026-112 and OCMS-SR-2026-190 only touch refund ID logic and the Exception report.

steps.step: OCMS sends refund advice to Cumulus
steps.detail: No code sends the refund advice to Cumulus. Grep for cumulus, refund advice and synonyms across all repos (UI and API) found no integration. Entity OcmsRefundNotices only has refund data columns up to refundReason at line 58; the file ends at line 62 with no send-status column. There is no SFTP/HTTP client to Cumulus.

steps.step: OCMS receives refund status from Cumulus
steps.detail: No code receives a refund status (successful/unsuccessful) from Cumulus. There is no inbound endpoint, cron or reply-file parser; thirdpartyapi has no refund or Cumulus reference. The entity has no refund status column.

steps.step: Failure reason such as invalid bank account is kept
steps.detail: No storage for a failure reason from Cumulus (for example invalid bank account). The only reason column is refundReason at line 58 (length 3), which is the reason OCMS itself raised the refund, not a rejection reason from Cumulus.

steps.step: Officer can see refund records to follow up
steps.detail: Officers can only see refund records through POST /v1/refundnoticelist (ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:36) and the refund column in the PS report (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportListPS.tsx:265). The Epic46 Refund UI pages in ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:343-358 sit inside a comment block (the Epic46 import is also commented, App.tsx:60). There is no Cumulus status to follow up on; only the refund list is available.
